references.text: Parallel boundary description for Benjamin mentioning the Valley of Hinnom and the Jebusite slope, the same geographical reference points as in Joshua 15:8
Mentions Topheth in the Valley of Hinnom (Ben-Hinnom), the same valley referred to as a boundary marker
Refers to the Valley of Ben-Hinnom where idolatry took place
Mentions the Valley of Ben-Hinnom in connection with Manasseh's sins
Prophetic judgment against the Valley of Ben-Hinnom, the same valley mentioned as a boundary marker
Jeremiah prophesies in the Valley of Ben-Hinnom about coming judgment
Mentions the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem, the same people referred to by 'the Jebusite slope'
The Valley of Rephaim is mentioned as a battlefield, the same valley noted as a northern boundary marker
David captures Jerusalem from the Jebusites, the city identified with the Jebusite slope
The Valley of Rephaim is described as a fertile valley, the same valley marking the northern boundary
